lessons.title: Greetings
lessons.summary: First class: saying hello and thank you, asking politely, and the words for teacher and student.

sections.title: Saying hello
sections.body:
你好 works at any time of day. 早安 is only for the morning.
- 你好 — hello
- 謝謝 — thank you
- 再見 — goodbye

sections.title: Asking politely
sections.body: Start a question to a stranger with **請問**. It softens anything that follows.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ，ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄨㄣˋ ㄋㄧˇ ㄕˋ ㄌㄠˇ ㄕ ˙ㄇㄚ
dialogue.translation: Hello, excuse me, are you the teacher?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: bú shì, wǒ shì xué shēng

lessons.title: Ordering drinks
lessons.summary: Ordering at a drink stand, asking the price, and comparing two things with 比.

sections.title: At the counter
sections.body:
- 我要一杯咖啡 — I want a cup of coffee
- 這個多少錢？ — how much is this?

sections.title: Comparing with 比
sections.body: A 比 B + adjective: **茶比咖啡便宜** — tea is cheaper than coffee.

sections.title: Drink stands
sections.body: Sweetness (甜度) and ice (冰塊) are ordered separately: 半糖少冰 is half sugar, less ice.

grammar.explanation: Put 比 between the two things being compared; the adjective comes last and never takes 很.
